groups.name: Wh- + to be
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + am / is / are + chủ ngữ? Đảo to be lên trước chủ ngữ: She is a nurse → What is she?

items.p: My name is [Lan].
en: What is your name?
items.w: Hỏi tên → What + is + your name. Đổi my → your khi hỏi lại người nói.

items.p: She is [a nurse].
en: What is she?
What does she do?
items.w: Hỏi nghề nghiệp: What is she? hoặc What does she do?

items.p: They are [in the library].
en: Where are they?
items.w: Hỏi nơi chốn → Where; chủ ngữ số nhiều → are.

items.p: He is [twenty-two] years old.
en: How old is he?
items.w: Hỏi tuổi → How old + is + he.

items.p: The meeting is [at 9 a.m.].
en: What time is the meeting?
When is the meeting?
items.w: Giờ cụ thể → What time; When cũng đúng.

items.p: My favourite subject is [Maths].
en: What is your favourite subject?
items.w: my → your; is đứng trước chủ ngữ dài "your favourite subject".

items.p: I am [from Hai Phong].
en: Where are you from?
items.w: Hỏi quê → Where + are + you + from? Giới từ from để ở cuối câu.

items.p: The weather is [cold and windy] today.
en: What is the weather like today?
How is the weather today?
items.w: Hỏi thời tiết → What is … like? hoặc How is …?

items.p: Her new phone is [black].
en: What colour is her new phone?
items.w: Hỏi màu → What colour + is + danh từ.

items.p: [My brother] is in the kitchen.
en: Who is in the kitchen?
items.w: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ là người → Who + is …, không đảo.

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Bạn có khỏe không?
en: How are you?
items.w: Hỏi sức khỏe → How are you?

items.p: Hỏi xem cái túi này giá bao nhiêu.
en: How much is this bag?
How much does this bag cost?
items.w: Hỏi giá → How much is …? hoặc How much does … cost?

groups.name: Câu hỏi Yes / No với to be
groups.tip: Đưa am / is / are lên đầu câu: You are tired → Are you tired? Trả lời Yes, I am / No, I'm not.

items.p: [Yes], I am a student.
en: Are you a student?
items.w: Trả lời "Yes, I am" → hỏi Are you …?

items.p: [No], she isn't at home.
en: Is she at home?
items.w: isn't → câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng Is.

items.p: [Yes], they are ready.
en: Are they ready?
items.w: they → Are they …?

items.p: [No], the shop isn't open on Sundays.
en: Is the shop open on Sundays?
items.w: Chủ ngữ số ít "the shop" → Is.

items.p: [Yes], there is a bank near here.
en: Is there a bank near here?
items.w: There is → Is there …?

items.p: [No], there aren't any eggs in the fridge.
en: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
items.w: There are → Are there any …? Câu hỏi dùng any.

items.p: [Yes], it is your book.
en: Is it my book?
items.w: your (người trả lời nói) → my (người hỏi nói).

items.p: [No], we aren't late.
en: Are we late?
items.w: we → Are we …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Đây có phải là lần đầu bạn đến Hà Nội không?
en: Is this your first time in Hanoi?
Is this your first visit to Hanoi?
items.w: Là / phải không → dùng to be: Is this …?

items.p: Hỏi xem trong phòng có wifi không.
en: Is there wifi in the room?
Is there wi-fi in the room?
Does the room have wifi?
items.w: "Có … không" (tồn tại) → Is there …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bố mẹ bạn ấy có ở nhà không.
en: Are your parents at home?
Are your parents home?
items.w: Chủ ngữ số nhiều → Are.

groups.name: Wh- + do / does
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + do / does + chủ ngữ + động từ NGUYÊN MẪU. He works → Where does he work? (works → work)

items.p: I live [in Ha Dong].
en: Where do you live?
items.w: Động từ thường → mượn do; I → you.

items.p: She works [at a bank].
en: Where does she work?
items.w: she → does; works → work (bỏ s).

items.p: He gets up [at six o'clock].
en: What time does he get up?
When does he get up?
items.w: does + get up (bỏ s ở gets).

items.p: They go to school [by bus].
en: How do they go to school?
items.w: Hỏi phương tiện → How.

items.p: My father drinks [coffee] every morning.
en: What does your father drink every morning?
items.w: drinks → does … drink.

items.p: She studies English [because she wants to work abroad].
en: Why does she study English?
items.w: studies → does … study (không giữ -ies).

items.p: The film starts [at 8 p.m.].
en: What time does the film start?
When does the film start?
items.w: starts → does … start.

items.p: We have lunch [in the canteen].
en: Where do you have lunch?
items.w: we → you; have giữ nguyên.

items.p: My sister likes [K-pop].
en: What kind of music does your sister like?
What does your sister like?
items.w: likes → does … like.

items.p: [Minh] teaches us Maths.
en: Who teaches you Maths?
items.w: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ → Who + teaches (giữ s, KHÔNG dùng does).

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy thường làm gì vào cuối tuần.
en: What do you usually do at the weekend?
What do you usually do at weekends?
What do you usually do on weekends?
items.w: usually đứng sau chủ ngữ, trước động từ chính.

items.p: Hỏi xem từ "career" nghĩa là gì.
en: What does career mean?
What does the word career mean?
items.w: mean → What does … mean? (không dùng "What is mean")

groups.name: Do / Does … ? và How often
groups.tip: Do / Does + chủ ngữ + V nguyên mẫu? Hỏi tần suất → How often do / does …?

items.p: [Yes], I like spicy food.
en: Do you like spicy food?
items.w: Yes, I do → Do you …?

items.p: [No], he doesn't play football.
en: Does he play football?
items.w: doesn't → Does he + play.

items.p: [Yes], my mother cooks every day.
en: Does your mother cook every day?
items.w: cooks → Does … cook.

items.p: I go to the gym [three times a week].
en: How often do you go to the gym?
items.w: Tần suất → How often.

items.p: She checks her email [every hour].
en: How often does she check her email?
items.w: checks → does … check.

items.p: [No], they don't live near the university.
en: Do they live near the university?
items.w: don't → Do they …?

items.p: It [rarely] rains here in December.
en: How often does it rain here in December?
items.w: It + rains → does it rain.

items.p: [Yes], the bus stops here.
en: Does the bus stop here?
items.w: Chủ ngữ số ít → Does.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy có nói được tiếng Trung không.
en: Do you speak Chinese?
Can you speak Chinese?
items.w: speak → Do you speak …? (Can you … cũng đúng)

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy có thích công việc hiện tại không.
en: Do you like your job?
Do you like your current job?
Do you enjoy your job?
Do you enjoy your current job?
items.w: Do you like …?

items.p: Hỏi xem chị gái bạn có làm việc ở Hà Nội không.
en: Does your sister work in Hanoi?
items.w: sister → Does; work giữ nguyên.

groups.name: Hiện tại tiếp diễn
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + am / is / are + chủ ngữ + V-ing? She is reading → What is she reading?

items.p: She is reading [a novel].
en: What is she reading?
items.w: Giữ V-ing, đảo is lên trước she.

items.p: They are waiting [for the bus].
en: What are they waiting for?
Who are they waiting for?
items.w: wait for → giới từ for để cuối câu.

items.p: I am studying [for my IELTS exam].
en: What are you studying for?
items.w: I am → are you.

items.p: [Yes], it is raining now.
en: Is it raining now?
items.w: Yes/No → Is it raining?

items.p: He is talking [to his manager].
en: Who is he talking to?
items.w: talk to → Who … to?

items.p: We are staying [at a small hotel].
en: Where are you staying?
items.w: we → you.

items.p: The children are crying [because they are hungry].
en: Why are the children crying?
items.w: Lý do → Why.

items.p: [No], I'm not working this weekend.
en: Are you working this weekend?
items.w: Tiếp diễn chỉ kế hoạch tương lai gần → Are you working …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy đang làm gì vậy.
en: What are you doing?
items.w: đang làm → What are you doing?

items.p: Hỏi xem dạo này bạn ấy đang đọc sách gì.
en: What book are you reading at the moment?
What are you reading these days?
What book are you reading these days?
What are you reading at the moment?
items.w: Hành động đang diễn ra quanh thời điểm nói → tiếp diễn.

groups.name: Quá khứ đơn
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + did + chủ ngữ + V NGUYÊN MẪU? went → did … go. Với was / were thì đảo lên đầu như to be.

items.p: I went [to Da Nang] last summer.
en: Where did you go last summer?
items.w: went → did … go (không viết "did you went").

items.p: She bought [a new laptop] yesterday.
en: What did she buy yesterday?
items.w: bought → did … buy.

items.p: They arrived [at midnight].
en: What time did they arrive?
When did they arrive?
items.w: arrived → did … arrive.

items.p: He left the company [in 2022].
en: When did he leave the company?
items.w: left → did … leave.

items.p: We met [at a friend's party].
en: Where did you meet?
items.w: met → did … meet.

items.p: She was late [because of the traffic].
en: Why was she late?
items.w: was → Why was she …? (không thêm did với was)

items.p: The trip was [wonderful].
en: How was the trip?
items.w: Hỏi cảm nhận → How was …?

items.p: [Yes], I finished the report.
en: Did you finish the report?
items.w: Yes, I did → Did you finish …?

items.p: I was [at home] last night.
en: Where were you last night?
items.w: I was → were you.

items.p: [No], they weren't at the meeting.
en: Were they at the meeting?
items.w: weren't → Were they …?

items.p: [Tom] broke the window.
en: Who broke the window?
items.w: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ → Who + broke, không dùng did.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy đã làm gì vào tối qua.
en: What did you do last night?
items.w: Quá khứ → did + do.

items.p: Hỏi xem kỳ nghỉ của bạn ấy thế nào.
en: How was your holiday?
How was your vacation?
items.w: How was …?

groups.name: Quá khứ tiếp diễn
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + was / were + chủ ngữ + V-ing? Thường đi với "when / at 8 p.m. yesterday".

items.p: I was watching [TV] when you called.
en: What were you watching when I called?
What were you doing when I called?
items.w: I was → were you; you called → I called.

items.p: She was living [in Hue] in 2020.
en: Where was she living in 2020?
items.w: was + living, đảo was.

items.p: At 9 p.m. yesterday they were [having dinner].
en: What were they doing at 9 p.m. yesterday?
items.w: Hỏi hành động → What were they doing?

items.p: He was driving [too fast] when the accident happened.
en: How was he driving when the accident happened?
items.w: Hỏi cách thức → How.

items.p: [Yes], it was raining when we left.
en: Was it raining when you left?
items.w: we left → you left.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy đang làm gì lúc mất điện.
en: What were you doing when the power went out?
What were you doing when the power cut happened?
What were you doing when the electricity went off?
items.w: Hành động đang dở thì bị cắt ngang → quá khứ tiếp diễn.

groups.name: Will / be going to
groups.tip: Will + chủ ngữ + V? hoặc am / is / are + chủ ngữ + going to + V?

items.p: I will call you [tomorrow].
en: When will you call me?
items.w: will → đảo lên trước you; you → me.

items.p: She is going to study [in Australia].
en: Where is she going to study?
items.w: is going to → is she going to study.

items.p: They are going to buy [a new car].
en: What are they going to buy?
items.w: Giữ going to + V.

items.p: The project will finish [next month].
en: When will the project finish?
items.w: will finish → When will … finish.

items.p: [Yes], I will help you.
en: Will you help me?
items.w: I will → Will you …? ; you → me.

items.p: We are going to visit [our grandparents] this weekend.
en: Who are you going to visit this weekend?
items.w: Hỏi người là tân ngữ → Who + are you going to visit.

items.p: He is going to quit his job [because he wants to start a business].
en: Why is he going to quit his job?
items.w: Lý do → Why.

items.p: Hỏi bạn ấy sẽ làm gì sau khi tốt nghiệp.
en: What are you going to do after graduation?
What will you do after graduation?
What are you going to do after you graduate?
What will you do after you graduate?
items.w: Kế hoạch → be going to (will cũng chấp nhận).

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy có đến bữa tiệc tối nay không.
en: Are you coming to the party tonight?
Will you come to the party tonight?
Are you going to come to the party tonight?
items.w: Kế hoạch đã định → hiện tại tiếp diễn hoặc be going to.

groups.name: How much / many / long / far · Which · Whose
groups.tip: many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều; much + không đếm được; How long = bao lâu; How far = bao xa; Whose = của ai.

items.p: I have [two] brothers.
en: How many brothers do you have?
items.w: Đếm được số nhiều → How many + brothers.

items.p: She drinks [two litres of] water a day.
en: How much water does she drink a day?
items.w: water không đếm được → How much water.

items.p: The course costs [five million dong].
en: How much does the course cost?
How much is the course?
items.w: Hỏi giá → How much.

items.p: It takes [thirty minutes] to get to work.
en: How long does it take to get to work?
items.w: Hỏi thời gian bỏ ra → How long does it take …?

items.p: My house is [about two kilometres] from here.
en: How far is your house from here?
items.w: Khoảng cách → How far.

items.p: This is [Mai's] umbrella.
en: Whose umbrella is this?
Whose is this umbrella?
items.w: Của ai → Whose + danh từ.

items.p: I prefer [the blue] shirt.
en: Which shirt do you prefer?
items.w: Chọn trong số có sẵn → Which.

items.p: There are [forty] students in my class.
en: How many students are there in your class?
items.w: There are → How many … are there?

items.p: We stayed in Japan [for ten days].
en: How long did you stay in Japan?
items.w: for ten days → How long; stayed → did … stay.

items.p: I need [some] sugar.
en: How much sugar do you need?
items.w: sugar không đếm được → How much.

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy học tiếng Anh được bao lâu rồi.
en: How long have you studied English?
How long have you been studying English?
How long have you learned English?
How long have you been learning English?
items.w: "được bao lâu rồi" (đến nay) → How long have you …?

items.p: Hỏi xem ở cửa hàng có bao nhiêu nhân viên.
en: How many staff are there in the shop?
How many employees are there in the shop?
How many people work in the shop?
How many employees does the shop have?
items.w: employees đếm được → How many.

groups.name: Hiện tại hoàn thành
groups.tip: Have / Has + chủ ngữ + V3? Ever = đã từng; How long … for / since; yet trong câu hỏi.

items.p: [Yes], I have been to Singapore.
en: Have you ever been to Singapore?
Have you been to Singapore?
items.w: Kinh nghiệm → Have you ever been to …?

items.p: She has worked here [for five years].
en: How long has she worked here?
How long has she been working here?
items.w: for five years → How long has she worked …?

items.p: They have lived in this city [since 2019].
en: How long have they lived in this city?
How long have they been living in this city?
Since when have they lived in this city?
items.w: since 2019 → How long have they lived …?

items.p: [No], he hasn't finished his homework yet.
en: Has he finished his homework yet?
Has he finished his homework?
items.w: hasn't → Has he finished … yet?

items.p: I have read [three] books this month.
en: How many books have you read this month?
items.w: How many + books + have you read.

items.p: We have just eaten [pizza].
en: What have you just eaten?
What have you eaten?
items.w: have eaten → What have you eaten?

items.p: She has visited [Japan and Korea].
en: Which countries has she visited?
What countries has she visited?
items.w: has visited → Which countries has she visited?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy đã từng ăn sầu riêng chưa.
en: Have you ever eaten durian?
Have you ever tried durian?
items.w: "đã từng … chưa" → Have you ever + V3.

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy đã nộp bài tập chưa.
en: Have you submitted your assignment yet?
Have you handed in your assignment yet?
Have you submitted your homework yet?
Have you handed in your homework yet?
Have you submitted your assignment?
Have you handed in your assignment?
items.w: "đã … chưa" → Have you … yet?

groups.name: Can · Should · Must / Have to · Could you…?
groups.tip: Can / Should / Must + chủ ngữ + V? Have to mượn do: Do I have to …? Lời đề nghị lịch sự: Could you …?

items.p: [Yes], I can swim.
en: Can you swim?
items.w: can → Can you + V.

items.p: You should take [a taxi].
en: What should I take?
What should I do?
items.w: You should → What should I …?

items.p: We have to arrive [before 7 a.m.].
en: When do we have to arrive?
What time do we have to arrive?
items.w: have to → do we have to (mượn do).

items.p: [No], you don't have to wear a uniform.
en: Do I have to wear a uniform?
items.w: don't have to → Do I have to …?

items.p: She can play [the piano and the guitar].
en: What can she play?
What instruments can she play?
items.w: can play → What can she play?

items.p: You can park [behind the building].
en: Where can I park?
items.w: You can → Where can I …?

items.p: Hỏi nhờ người khác nói chậm lại một cách lịch sự.
en: Could you speak more slowly, please?
Could you please speak more slowly?
Can you speak more slowly, please?
Could you speak slowly, please?
items.w: Nhờ lịch sự → Could you …, please?

items.p: Hỏi ý kiến: Tôi có nên học thêm một ngoại ngữ nữa không?
en: Should I learn another foreign language?
Should I learn another language?
Should I study another foreign language?
Should I study another language?
items.w: Xin lời khuyên → Should I …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn có thể mượn bút của người ấy không.
en: Can I borrow your pen?
Could I borrow your pen?
May I borrow your pen?
items.w: Xin phép → Can / Could / May I …?

groups.name: Hỏi chủ ngữ hay hỏi tân ngữ
groups.tip: Hỏi CHỦ NGỮ (Who / What làm việc đó?) → không dùng do / does / did, động từ chia như câu thường: Who called you? Hỏi TÂN NGỮ → có trợ động từ: Who did you call?

items.p: [Linh] called me last night.
en: Who called you last night?
items.w: Linh là người gọi (chủ ngữ) → Who called …? (KHÔNG "Who did call")

items.p: I called [Linh] last night.
en: Who did you call last night?
items.w: Linh là người được gọi (tân ngữ) → Who did you call?

items.p: [A strange noise] woke me up.
en: What woke you up?
items.w: Chủ ngữ là vật → What + woke.

items.p: The storm damaged [the roof].
en: What did the storm damage?
items.w: roof là tân ngữ → What did the storm damage?

items.p: [Most students] prefer online classes.
en: Who prefers online classes?
How many students prefer online classes?
items.w: Hỏi chủ ngữ → Who prefers (động từ số ít sau Who).

items.p: [An accident] happened on the bridge.
en: What happened on the bridge?
items.w: happen không có tân ngữ → What happened …? (không dùng did)

items.p: My boss gave me [a bonus].
en: What did your boss give you?
items.w: bonus là tân ngữ → What did … give …?

items.p: [My mother] cooks dinner in my family.
en: Who cooks dinner in your family?
items.w: Chủ ngữ → Who cooks (giữ s).

items.p: Hỏi xem ai đã viết cuốn sách này.
en: Who wrote this book?
items.w: Hỏi chủ ngữ ở quá khứ → Who wrote …? (không dùng did)

items.p: Hỏi xem chuyện gì đã xảy ra với điện thoại của bạn ấy.
en: What happened to your phone?
items.w: happen to → What happened to …?

groups.name: Giới từ ở cuối câu hỏi
groups.tip: Động từ đi với giới từ (listen to, look for, worry about, depend on…) → giới từ để ở CUỐI câu hỏi: Who are you talking to?

items.p: She is listening [to jazz].
en: What is she listening to?
items.w: listen to → What … listening to?

items.p: I am worried [about my exam].
en: What are you worried about?
items.w: worried about → What … worried about?

items.p: He is looking [for his keys].
en: What is he looking for?
items.w: look for → What … looking for?

items.p: The decision depends [on the price].
en: What does the decision depend on?
items.w: depend on → What does … depend on?

items.p: They are talking [about the new project].
en: What are they talking about?
items.w: talk about → What … about?

items.p: I live [with my cousins].
en: Who do you live with?
items.w: live with → Who do you live with?

items.p: This letter is [from the bank].
en: Who is this letter from?
Where is this letter from?
items.w: from → Who … from?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy quan tâm đến lĩnh vực gì.
en: What are you interested in?
What field are you interested in?
Which field are you interested in?
items.w: interested in → What are you interested in?

groups.name: Câu hỏi bị động
groups.tip: Từ để hỏi + is / are / was / were + chủ ngữ + V3? The bridge was built in 1902 → When was the bridge built?

items.p: The bridge was built [in 1902].
en: When was the bridge built?
items.w: was built → When was … built?

items.p: Coffee is grown [in the Central Highlands].
en: Where is coffee grown?
items.w: is grown → Where is coffee grown?

items.p: The novel was written [by Nguyen Du].
en: Who was the novel written by?
Who wrote the novel?
items.w: was written by → Who … written by? (hoặc Who wrote …?)

items.p: These phones are made [in Viet Nam].
en: Where are these phones made?
items.w: are made → Where are … made?

items.p: The meeting was cancelled [because of the storm].
en: Why was the meeting cancelled?
items.w: was cancelled → Why was … cancelled?

items.p: [Yes], the windows are cleaned every week.
en: Are the windows cleaned every week?
items.w: Yes/No bị động → Are + chủ ngữ + V3?

items.p: Hỏi xem ngôi chùa này được xây khi nào.
en: When was this pagoda built?
When was this temple built?
items.w: Bị động quá khứ → When was … built?

items.p: Hỏi xem tiếng Anh có được dạy ở trường tiểu học không.
en: Is English taught in primary schools?
Is English taught at primary schools?
items.w: Bị động hiện tại → Is English taught …?

groups.name: Câu hỏi gián tiếp (lịch sự)
groups.tip: Could you tell me / Do you know + từ để hỏi + CHỦ NGỮ + ĐỘNG TỪ (không đảo, không do / does / did): Where is the station? → Could you tell me where the station is?

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Could you tell me): Nhà ga ở đâu?
en: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where the train station is?
items.w: Câu gián tiếp → where + the station + is (không đảo: KHÔNG "where is the station").

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Do you know): Mấy giờ thì cửa hàng đóng cửa?
en: Do you know what time the shop closes?
Do you know when the shop closes?
items.w: Bỏ does: What time does the shop close? → what time the shop closes (thêm s lại).

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Could you tell me): Vé giá bao nhiêu?
en: Could you tell me how much the ticket is?
Could you tell me how much the ticket costs?
Could you tell me how much the tickets are?
Could you tell me how much the tickets cost?
items.w: how much + the ticket + is / costs.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Do you know): Anh ấy đã đi đâu?
en: Do you know where he went?
items.w: Bỏ did: Where did he go? → where he went (động từ về quá khứ).

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Can you tell me): Bài thi bắt đầu khi nào?
en: Can you tell me when the exam starts?
Can you tell me what time the exam starts?
Can you tell me when the test starts?
items.w: when + the exam + starts.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng I wonder): Liệu cô ấy có đến không?
en: I wonder if she will come.
I wonder whether she will come.
I wonder if she is coming.
I wonder whether she is coming.
items.w: Câu hỏi Yes/No gián tiếp → if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Do you know): Phòng 201 ở tầng mấy?
en: Do you know which floor room 201 is on?
Do you know what floor room 201 is on?
items.w: which floor + room 201 + is on (giới từ cuối câu).

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự (bắt đầu bằng Could you tell me): Tôi nên điền mẫu đơn này như thế nào?
en: Could you tell me how I should fill in this form?
Could you tell me how to fill in this form?
Could you tell me how I should fill out this form?
Could you tell me how to fill out this form?
items.w: how + I + should + V, hoặc gọn hơn: how to + V.

groups.name: Quán ăn & cà phê
groups.tip: Gọi món, gọi thanh toán: Could I have …, please? · Can we …? · How much is …?

items.p: Hỏi nhân viên: Hóa đơn của tôi là bao nhiêu?
en: How much is my bill?
How much is the bill?
How much do I owe you?
items.w: Hỏi số tiền → How much is …? (bill = hóa đơn)

items.p: Gọi nhân viên để thanh toán: Cho tôi xin hóa đơn.
en: Could I have the bill, please?
Could we have the bill, please?
Can I get the bill, please?
Could I have the check, please?
items.w: Xin cái gì → Could I have …, please? (Anh: bill · Mỹ: check)

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể trả bằng thẻ không.
en: Can I pay by card?
Do you accept cards?
Can I pay with a card?
Do you take cards?
items.w: Phương thức trả tiền → pay by card / in cash.

items.p: Hỏi xem quán có thực đơn tiếng Anh không.
en: Do you have an English menu?
Is there an English menu?
Do you have a menu in English?
items.w: Hỏi quán có gì → Do you have …?

items.p: Gọi thêm một cốc nước.
en: Could I have another glass of water, please?
Could I have some more water, please?
Could I have a glass of water, please?
items.w: another = thêm một cái nữa; some more + danh từ không đếm được.

items.p: Hỏi xem món này có cay không.
en: Is this dish spicy?
Is this spicy?
Is it spicy?
items.w: Tính chất món → Is this … spicy?

items.p: Hỏi nhân viên món nào được gọi nhiều nhất.
en: What is your most popular dish?
What do you recommend?
What would you recommend?
items.w: Xin gợi ý → What do you recommend?

items.p: Hỏi xem có bàn trống cho 4 người không.
en: Do you have a table for four?
Is there a table for four?
Have you got a table for four?
items.w: a table for four = bàn cho 4 người.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể mang đồ ăn thừa về không.
en: Can I take this away?
Could I have a box for this, please?
Can I take the rest home?
Could I get this to go?
items.w: take away / to go = mang về.

items.p: Hỏi mật khẩu wifi của quán.
en: What is the wifi password?
What's the password for the wifi?
Could you tell me the wifi password?
items.w: What is the … password?

items.p: Hỏi xem đã bao gồm phí phục vụ chưa.
en: Is service included?
Is the service charge included?
Does the bill include service?
items.w: included = đã bao gồm.

groups.name: Phòng thi & lớp học
groups.tip: Xin phép, hỏi quy định: Could I …? · Can I …? · How many / How long …? · Do we have to …?

items.p: Hỏi giám thị: Em có thể viết bài trên mấy tờ giấy?
en: How many sheets of paper can I use?
How many pages can I write?
How many sheets can I write on?
How many pieces of paper can I use?
items.w: Số lượng giấy → How many sheets / pieces of paper (paper không đếm được nên phải dùng sheets).

items.p: Xin giám thị: Cho em xin thêm giấy thi.
en: Could I have some more paper, please?
Could I have another sheet of paper, please?
Could I have an extra answer sheet, please?
Could I have more paper, please?
Could I have another answer sheet, please?
items.w: Xin thêm → Could I have some more / another …, please?

items.p: Hỏi: Còn bao nhiêu thời gian nữa ạ?
en: How much time do we have left?
How much time is left?
How long do we have left?
How many minutes are left?
items.w: time không đếm được → How much time …? left = còn lại.

items.p: Xin phép đi vệ sinh.
en: Could I go to the toilet, please?
Could I go to the bathroom, please?
May I go to the toilet?
Could I use the toilet, please?
items.w: Xin phép làm gì → Could / May I + V?

items.p: Hỏi xem có được dùng máy tính cầm tay không.
en: Can we use a calculator?
Are we allowed to use a calculator?
Can I use a calculator?
Are calculators allowed?
items.w: Hỏi quy định → Can we …? / Are we allowed to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có phải viết bằng bút mực không.
en: Do we have to write in pen?
Do I have to use a pen?
Do we have to use a pen?
Do I have to write in pen?
items.w: Bắt buộc không → Do we have to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có được viết bằng bút chì không.
en: Can I write in pencil?
Can I use a pencil?
Are we allowed to use a pencil?
Can we write in pencil?
items.w: in pencil / in pen = bằng bút chì / bút mực.

items.p: Hỏi giám thị: Em nộp bài ở đâu ạ?
en: Where do I hand in my paper?
Where should I put my paper?
Where do I submit my paper?
Where do I hand in my answer sheet?
items.w: hand in = nộp.

items.p: Nhờ thầy cô nhắc lại câu hỏi.
en: Could you repeat the question, please?
Could you say that again, please?
Could you repeat that, please?
items.w: Nhờ làm gì → Could you + V, please?

items.p: Hỏi: Khi nào có kết quả thi ạ?
en: When will the results be available?
When will we get our results?
When will the results come out?
When can we see our results?
items.w: Tương lai → When will …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bài này nộp hạn chót khi nào.
en: When is the deadline?
When is the assignment due?
When do we have to submit it?
When is the deadline for this assignment?
items.w: due = đến hạn; deadline = hạn chót.

items.p: Hỏi: Từ này đọc như thế nào ạ?
en: How do you pronounce this word?
How do you say this word?
How is this word pronounced?
items.w: Cách làm gì → How do you + V?

items.p: Hỏi: Cái này tiếng Anh gọi là gì?
en: What is this called in English?
What do you call this in English?
How do you say this in English?
items.w: be called = được gọi là.

groups.name: Mua sắm
groups.tip: Hỏi giá, size, đổi trả: How much …? · Do you have … in …? · Can I try …?

items.p: Hỏi giá chiếc áo này.
en: How much is this shirt?
How much does this shirt cost?
How much is this?
items.w: How much is + danh từ số ít.

items.p: Hỏi giá đôi giày này.
en: How much are these shoes?
How much do these shoes cost?
How much are these?
items.w: shoes số nhiều → How much ARE these shoes?

items.p: Hỏi xem có size nhỏ hơn không.
en: Do you have a smaller size?
Do you have this in a smaller size?
Have you got a smaller size?
Is there a smaller size?
items.w: So sánh hơn → a smaller size.

items.p: Hỏi xem có màu khác không.
en: Do you have this in another colour?
Do you have it in a different colour?
Does it come in other colours?
Do you have this in other colours?
items.w: in another colour = màu khác.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể mặc thử không.
en: Can I try it on?
Could I try this on?
Can I try this on?
Where can I try it on?
items.w: try on = mặc thử; đại từ đứng giữa: try it on.

items.p: Hỏi xem có được giảm giá không.
en: Can you give me a discount?
Is there a discount?
Could you give me a discount?
Can I get a discount?
items.w: discount = giảm giá.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đổi hàng nếu không vừa không.
en: Can I exchange it if it doesn't fit?
Can I change it if it doesn't fit?
Can I return it if it doesn't fit?
items.w: exchange = đổi; return = trả lại.

items.p: Hỏi xem cửa hàng mấy giờ đóng cửa.
en: What time do you close?
When do you close?
What time does the shop close?
items.w: Lịch cố định → hiện tại đơn: What time do you close?

items.p: Hỏi xem có túi không.
en: Could I have a bag, please?
Can I get a bag?
Do you have a bag?
items.w: Could I have …?

groups.name: Đi lại & hỏi đường
groups.tip: Where is …? · How do I get to …? · How long does it take …? · Does this bus go to …?

items.p: Hỏi đường đến ga tàu gần nhất.
en: How do I get to the nearest train station?
Where is the nearest train station?
Could you tell me the way to the nearest station?
How do I get to the nearest station?
Where is the nearest station?
items.w: Hỏi đường → How do I get to …?

items.p: Hỏi xem xe buýt này có đi đến sân bay không.
en: Does this bus go to the airport?
items.w: this bus số ít → Does … go …?

items.p: Hỏi xem đi đến đó mất bao lâu.
en: How long does it take to get there?
How long will it take to get there?
How long does it take?
items.w: Thời gian di chuyển → How long does it take …?

items.p: Hỏi xem chỗ đó có xa đây không.
en: Is it far from here?
How far is it from here?
Is it far?
items.w: far = xa.

items.p: Hỏi tài xế: Đi đến địa chỉ này hết bao nhiêu tiền?
en: How much is it to this address?
How much does it cost to go to this address?
How much will it cost to get to this address?
items.w: How much is it to + nơi đến?

items.p: Nhờ tài xế dừng ở đây.
en: Could you stop here, please?
Can you stop here, please?
items.w: Nhờ → Could you …?

items.p: Hỏi: Chuyến tàu tiếp theo mấy giờ chạy?
en: What time is the next train?
When is the next train?
What time does the next train leave?
items.w: What time is …? / What time does … leave?

items.p: Hỏi xem chỗ này đã có ai ngồi chưa.
en: Is this seat taken?
Is anyone sitting here?
Is this seat free?
items.w: taken = đã có người.

items.p: Hỏi nhà vệ sinh ở đâu.
en: Where is the toilet?
Where is the bathroom?
Where are the toilets?
Where is the restroom?
items.w: Where is …?

items.p: Hỏi: Tôi nên xuống ở trạm nào?
en: Which stop should I get off at?
Where should I get off?
Which stop do I get off at?
items.w: get off = xuống xe; giới từ at để cuối câu.

groups.name: Khách sạn & dịch vụ
groups.tip: Check-in, nhờ giúp: Could you …? · What time is …? · Is … included?

items.p: Hỏi lễ tân: Mấy giờ thì trả phòng?
en: What time is check-out?
When is check-out?
What time do I have to check out?
items.w: check-out = trả phòng.

items.p: Hỏi xem giá phòng có bao gồm bữa sáng không.
en: Is breakfast included?
Does the price include breakfast?
Is breakfast included in the price?
items.w: Is … included?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể gửi hành lý ở đây không.
en: Can I leave my luggage here?
Could I leave my bags here?
Can I leave my bags here?
items.w: leave luggage = gửi hành lý; luggage không đếm được.

items.p: Nhờ lễ tân gọi taxi giúp.
en: Could you call a taxi for me, please?
Could you call me a taxi, please?
Could you get me a taxi, please?
items.w: call someone a taxi = gọi taxi cho ai.

items.p: Báo và hỏi: Điều hòa phòng tôi không chạy, anh có thể kiểm tra không?
en: Could you check the air conditioner in my room?
Could you check the air conditioning in my room, please?
Could someone check the air conditioner in my room?
items.w: Nhờ → Could you check …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể trả phòng muộn hơn không.
en: Can I check out late?
Could I have a late check-out?
Is late check-out possible?
Can I check out later?
items.w: late check-out = trả phòng muộn.

groups.name: Bác sĩ & hiệu thuốc
groups.tip: Hỏi cách dùng thuốc, đặt lịch: How often should I …? · Do I need …? · Can I make an appointment …?

items.p: Hỏi dược sĩ: Thuốc này uống mấy lần một ngày?
en: How many times a day should I take this medicine?
How often should I take this medicine?
How many times a day do I take this?
How often should I take this?
items.w: Liều dùng → How often / How many times a day should I take …?

items.p: Hỏi xem có cần đơn của bác sĩ không.
en: Do I need a prescription?
Do I need a prescription for this?
items.w: prescription = đơn thuốc.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể đặt lịch khám vào sáng mai không.
en: Can I make an appointment for tomorrow morning?
Could I book an appointment for tomorrow morning?
Can I see the doctor tomorrow morning?
Could I make an appointment for tomorrow morning?
items.w: make / book an appointment = đặt lịch hẹn.

items.p: Hỏi xem uống thuốc trước hay sau khi ăn.
en: Should I take it before or after meals?
Should I take this before or after eating?
Do I take it before or after food?
Should I take it before or after food?
items.w: Câu hỏi lựa chọn: … before or after …?

items.p: Hỏi: Bao lâu thì tôi khỏi?
en: How long will it take to get better?
When will I get better?
How long will it take me to recover?
How long until I feel better?
items.w: get better / recover = khỏi bệnh.

groups.name: Công việc & văn phòng
groups.tip: Hỏi lịch, nhờ việc lịch sự: Could you send me …? · When is …? · Do you mind if I …?

items.p: Hỏi đồng nghiệp: Cuộc họp bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ?
en: What time does the meeting start?
When does the meeting start?
What time is the meeting?
When is the meeting?
items.w: Lịch cố định → What time does … start?

items.p: Nhờ đồng nghiệp gửi file báo cáo qua email.
en: Could you send me the report by email, please?
Could you email me the report, please?
Could you send the report to me by email?
Could you email the report to me?
items.w: email someone something = gửi email cho ai cái gì.

items.p: Hỏi xem có thể dời cuộc họp sang thứ Sáu không.
en: Could we move the meeting to Friday?
Can we reschedule the meeting for Friday?
Could we postpone the meeting until Friday?
Can we move the meeting to Friday?
items.w: move / reschedule = dời lịch.

items.p: Hỏi lịch sự xem mình có thể mở cửa sổ không.
en: Do you mind if I open the window?
Can I open the window?
Would you mind if I opened the window?
items.w: Do you mind if I + V hiện tại? (lịch sự)

items.p: Hỏi sếp: Em có thể nghỉ một ngày vào thứ Hai tới không ạ?
en: Can I take a day off next Monday?
Could I have next Monday off?
Could I take a day off next Monday?
Can I have next Monday off?
items.w: take a day off = nghỉ một ngày.

items.p: Hỏi xem máy in ở đâu.
en: Where is the printer?
Where can I find the printer?
items.w: Where is …?

items.p: Hỏi khi gọi điện: Tôi có thể nói chuyện với chị Lan không?
en: Could I speak to Lan, please?
Can I speak to Lan, please?
May I speak to Lan, please?
Is Lan there?
Could I speak with Lan, please?
items.w: Gọi điện tìm người → Could I speak to …, please?

items.p: Hỏi khi nghe không rõ trên điện thoại.
en: Could you speak up, please?
Sorry, could you say that again?
Could you repeat that, please?
Sorry, could you repeat that?
items.w: speak up = nói to hơn.

groups.name: Bạn bè & đời sống
groups.tip: Rủ rê, hỏi han: Would you like to …? · Shall we …? · What do you think of …? · How was …?

items.p: Rủ bạn đi xem phim tối nay.
en: Would you like to go to the cinema tonight?
Do you want to go to the cinema tonight?
Shall we go to the cinema tonight?
Would you like to see a film tonight?
Do you want to see a movie tonight?
items.w: Rủ rê lịch sự → Would you like to + V?

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Mình gặp nhau lúc mấy giờ?
en: What time shall we meet?
What time should we meet?
When shall we meet?
What time do we meet?
items.w: Hỏi để thống nhất → What time shall we …?

items.p: Hỏi bạn nghĩ gì về bộ phim.
en: What do you think of the film?
What did you think of the film?
What do you think about the film?
How did you like the film?
items.w: Xin ý kiến → What do you think of …?

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn có cần giúp gì không.
en: Do you need any help?
Can I help you?
Do you need help?
Can I help?
items.w: Do you need any help?

items.p: Hỏi mượn sạc điện thoại của bạn.
en: Can I borrow your phone charger?
Could I borrow your charger?
Can I borrow your charger?
items.w: borrow = mượn (từ người khác).

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn có rảnh vào thứ Bảy không.
en: Are you free on Saturday?
Are you free this Saturday?
Are you busy on Saturday?
items.w: free = rảnh → dùng to be.

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Dạo này bạn thế nào?
en: How have you been?
How are you doing?
How are things?
How is it going?
items.w: How have you been? (hỏi thăm sau một thời gian không gặp)

items.p: Hỏi xem bạn ấy làm nghề gì.
en: What do you do?
What do you do for a living?
What is your job?
items.w: Hỏi nghề → What do you do?

items.p: Hỏi bạn: Số điện thoại của bạn là gì?
en: What is your phone number?
